rule: r_A = share_A/n_A (recipe shares normalised over A..E, S excluded; n = cached seats); for k != A: share_k <= 4*r_A*n_k; all excess share goes to A; one pass from pre-cap r_A; recomputed every build
note: trainers sample buckets by effective_shares (not the raw recipe), then a seat uniformly within the bucket
